fact: Voosbur tells Thorin he is leaving because Thorin declined to join the Myconids.
source_quote: Voosbur remarked, "Hey, man, I guess you didn't want to join the party. I got to go now."
subject: Voosbur

fact: Voosbur and the other infected Myconids walk into a spore cloud and vanish.
source_quote: He and the rest of the infected Myconids gathered at a spore cloud among the fungal growths and stepped through it, vanishing entirely.
subject: Myconid departure

fact: The Myconids use a vast fungal network to travel between hidden places in the Underdark.
source_quote: They were traveling through some vast fungal network that connected the hidden places of the Underdark.
subject: fungal network

fact: The party spends three days underground in the Whorlstone Caverns.
source_quote: after three days underground, they made their way out of the Whorlstone Caverns.
subject: three days underground

fact: The party gains a fifth level.
source_quote: They rose to fifth level
subject: party level up

fact: Daz gains the spell Fireball upon reaching fifth level.
source_quote: and Daz finally gained Fireball.
subject: Daz

fact: Daz reconciles his spell counts, noting he has nine preparable spells and ten in his spellbook.
source_quote: Daz reconciles his "prepared 7 of 9 (10 known)" count: nine preparable spells, ten in his spellbook.
subject: Daz

fact: Daz comments that he needs a bigger spellbook.
source_quote: "I need a bigger spellbook."
subject: Daz

fact: Thorin's longsword now has a +8 to hit bonus.
source_quote: Thorin's longsword is now +8 to hit
subject: Thorin

fact: Thorin gains an extra attack.
source_quote: and he gains an extra attack.
subject: Thorin

fact: The party takes a long rest, recovering strength but losing Aid's temporary hit points.
source_quote: The party took a long rest, recovering their strength (and losing Aid's temporary hit points)
subject: long rest

fact: The long rest causes Aid's temporary hit points to vanish.
source_quote: The rest clears Aid's temporary hit points ("Bummer").
subject: Aid spell expiration

fact: Zalthir states that Gyrgum can simply cast Aid again.
source_quote: Zalthir notes Gyrgum can simply cast it again.
subject: Zalthir

fact: Zalthir states he does not need the long rest.
source_quote: Zalthir says he doesn't need it
subject: Zalthir

fact: The gates into the rest of Gracklstugh are sealed shut.
source_quote: The gates into the rest of Gracklstugh were sealed shut
subject: Gracklstugh

fact: Grim-faced Duergar in heavy armor guard the sealed gates of Gracklstugh.
source_quote: guarded by grim-faced Duergar in heavy armor
subject: Duergar

fact: The Drow on the other side of the gates are on edge.
source_quote: The drow on the other side were even more on edge than before
subject: Drow

fact: A Duergar guard named Gorglak steps forward to block the party's path.
source_quote: A particularly mean-looking guard named Gorglak stepped forward and blocked their path
subject: Gorglak

fact: Gorglak tells the party that they are not allowed in the city.
source_quote: "You, none of you are allowed. You should not be in here."
subject: Gorglak

fact: Gorglak demands to inspect the party's possessions for contraband.
source_quote: He demanded to inspect all of their possessions for contraband.
subject: Gorglak

fact: The party is holding a bag full of demonic artifacts and political secrets.
source_quote: holding a bag full of demonic artifacts and political secrets
subject: bag of artifacts

fact: Thorin attempts to use a 'diplomatic pouch' line to bypass inspection.
source_quote: Thorin tries the "diplomatic pouch" line.
subject: Thorin

fact: Daz offers to share mushrooms, suggesting they might be the contraband.
source_quote: Daz offers to share some mushrooms, "Maybe that's the contraband he's looking for."
subject: Daz
